para: The &crmshell;'s interactive mode is a dedicated, internal command shell that allows you to run multiple commands without needing to repeatedly type the crm prefix. You can also move down a level to a subcommand, such as crm configure, to run multiple commands at the same level. Changes you make in interactive mode are only applied to the live cluster after you commit them, which can be useful when configuring resources that are dependent on one another and require constraints. Interactive mode also supports tab completion.
